ordinary_single_extruder_route: Six separate supplied orientations, 0.4mm nozzle, 0.15mm first/later layers, 0.45mm line width, 100% rectilinear, 3mm external brim, supports off. Print separately, deburr externally, flip 02/04 back, glue 01-05 then rail06 onto04.
brim_access: All brim is on the open bed around an isolated part before assembly; no brim/support needs to pass the 7.2mm assembled terrace passage.
actual_slicer: PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 portable, official ZIP checksum verified
production_gcode_condition: Use the actual printer/PLA temperature, bed adhesion and start/end profile and reslice; supplied generic review Gcodes are not machine-ready.
